hints.title: Prime Factors 2 and 5
hints.text: The number of trailing zeros in a product is determined by min(count(2), count(5)).

hints.title: Cornered Path Structure
hints.text: A cornered path consists of an L-shape turning at some cell (r, c), combining one horizontal segment and one vertical segment meeting at (r, c).

hints.title: 2D Prefix Sums of Factor Pairs
hints.text: Precompute row prefix sums and column prefix sums for both factors 2 and 5.

hints.title: Four Corner Combinations Evaluation

complexity.notes: Factoring and prefix sums take O(R * C), and checking 4 corners per cell takes O(1).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Multiplying large path products exceeds precision and re-summing takes O(R * C * (R + C)).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix factor tables require O(R * C) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate abstracts product to factors of 2 and 5 and checks all 4 L-corners.
